name: ghostty
description: Ghostty integration: a 3-word summary as the tab title, a tab progress bar, ❓ and a notification when Claude waits on you, /goto between Claude sessions (waiting ones first), /workspace to save and reopen windows of sessions, and /keybind for Ghostty keys that type into Claude

tabTitle.title: Ghostty: smart tab title
tabTitle.description: Set the tab title to a 3-word summary of the session (a tiny Claude Haiku call)

titleMinutes.title: Ghostty: retitle every (minutes)
titleMinutes.description: How often the tab title can follow the session's topic

tabProgress.title: Ghostty: tab progress bar
tabProgress.description: Show a progress bar on the tab while Claude works; red after a failed tool call

waitingBadge.title: Ghostty: ❓ when Claude waits on you
waitingBadge.description: Put ❓ in the tab title while Claude waits for a permission or an answer

waitingNotification.title: Ghostty: notify when Claude waits on you
waitingNotification.description: auto: a desktop notification, unless the voice mod already says it out loud. always or never

keybinds.title: Ghostty: install Claude keybinds
keybinds.description: On first start, add ⌘⌃G for /goto to Ghostty (in its own claude-keybinds file, loaded by one line in your Ghostty config). /keybind adds your own
